title: Stable Coordinate Conjecture for Complex Polynomials
exact_target: If a polynomial $P\in\mathbb{C}[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ becomes equivalent to $x_1$ after adjoining finitely many variables, must $P$ already be a coordinate?
